description: This source file implements the CmasAnalyzer class, which is part of a system resource monitoring tool. It manages memory allocation tracking, logging, backtrace collection, and stats analysis, primarily for debugging and performance monitoring in the target system.

classes.name: CmasAnalyzer
classes.description: A class for analyzing system resource usage, specifically tracking memory allocations and deallocations, collecting backtraces, and logging statistics to analyze resource behavior over time.

methods.name: CmasAnalyzer::CmasAnalyzer
methods.description: Constructor for CmasAnalyzer that initializes the object with buffer size and filename, also calls the base class constructor.

methods.description: Sets the filename for logging, optionally adding a backtrace filename if backtrace collection is enabled.

methods.name: CmasAnalyzer::Insert (unsigned int allocator, int size, char *file, int line)
methods.description: Records an allocation event associated with an allocator, size, source file, and line number.

methods.name: CmasAnalyzer::Insert (unsigned int allocator, unsigned int deallocator, int size, char *file, int line)
methods.description: Records a deallocation event along with associated allocator, deallocator, size, source file, and line.

methods.name: CmasAnalyzer::Analyze
methods.description: Performs analysis of collected data, including logging stats and optionally handling backtrace data.

methods.name: CmasAnalyzer::LogCMAS
methods.description: Generates a detailed log of memory allocations, deallocations, and statistics, including backtrace info and resource usage delta over iterations.
